steps.content: You were screaming so terribly just now. Having a nightmare, were you? Don't worry, I've mercifully drawn out all the contamination from your body.
Christina tries to sit up but fails. Blood clogs her mouth, making breathing difficult. The surroundings are dark, or perhaps she hasn't regained her vision yet.

She only sees black, shattered marigolds at her hand—no, Mania contamination in the shape of marigolds. This reminds her of the fight in her nightmare, under the broken wall, where she battled many Corruptors and was contaminated.
But now, aside from the intermittent pain, her body doesn't seem to have that chaotic feeling anymore. Who helped handle the contamination in her body? In this... <color=#fb9259>blooming</color> way?
She only hears a familiar voice in the darkness, someone scrutinizing her.
The floor is hard, isn't it? Sorry about that. I should have offered a pillow to the injured, but with your whole body wounded, it would dirty my clothes. You'll have to bear with it.
Unlike the foul, bloody smell on her, she detects a fragrance of flowers and the sound of flowing water in her surroundings.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: What is this place?
This is my <color=#fb9259>Garden</color>. You're in the enemy's headquarters, little detective.
Do you remember me?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...I remember, murderer.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: Heh, with a doll-like face like yours, you should say something cute and pleasing. Come, call my name, <color=#fb9259>Coquelic</color>.
Christina is not in the mood to respond to her. Her consciousness, like her body, is heavy. She only wants to hold onto the most important thing.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Your cases, they are all acts of <color=#fb9259>vengeance</color> against what happened ten years ago, identical vengeance...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: But that's not your goal...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Through these cases, you want me to investigate something; to expose something that happened ten years ago...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Why didn't you just let me investigate directly? Why keep me in the dark? And the two lines of poetry, and the two people, just stop it here. I can investigate what you want, just stop...
Coquelic interrupts Christina.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The Garden is a place to enjoy life, can we not talk about boring work stuff?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Then why did you bring me here? To kill me? To interrogate me?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Let me think... Oh, someone recommended you to join the Garden.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Huh?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Hehe, such a cute reaction.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Since you're also a pitiful child of FAC, why don't you greet the little friends here?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: "Also"?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Over the years, so many people from FAC have died, wouldn't it be normal for a few children who share your plight to join the Garden? They quite like you.
...To join the Garden for revenge? Christina immediately understands this sentiment, her fists clenched.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: It's not the same... Even if I was treated unfairly, I don't want to harm others, I believe in justice...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: What's so different? Didn't you go to Nirvana by yourself eight years ago and stab a Paradeisos representative?

Christina's breath catches. Her reaction seems to greatly satisfy Coquelic. Mentor rises from the water, covered in water marks. The surrounding "assassins" gather to drape her in a thin veil, escorting her out of the bath, all the while laughing merrily.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You're quite the oddball, I say. You spout nonsense about justice and truth, yet your blossoming is pathetically dark. Even when bound and brought to my Garden, you're not surprised...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: It's because you're so used to it, aren't you? Your heart has been trapped in the dark all along.

Coquelic comes over to Christina, bending down to admire her prey. Her long white hair falls, brushing Christina's face. The water is cold, and Christina wants to dodge but can't move. She can only stare into Coquelic's bright red eyes.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: What happened back then that infuriated you to the point of committing such a serious act at such a young age?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Did the assassination succeed? Did you kill the person you hated to the bone?
Christina avoids her gaze, grits her teeth. She struggles to squeeze out an answer.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...It wasn't like that, and it has nothing to do with you. I won't tell you.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: So, the assassination failed. What a pity. You clearly have talent. You even became a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: As an assassin, an avenger, a person ignited by rage and burning everything. You have a talent for violence and destruction, just like the flowers here, that's why that woman kept you by her side.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Give up on your talk of justice, it's just a lie concocted by your Shalom, a chain she uses to bind you. Doesn't the case at hand prove this?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Anania, a shallow and vain woman, stands on moral high ground to denounce others. After hurting others, she got scared out of her wits, but in a few days, she whitewashed herself and returned to the high ground.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: That Nathan, a dirty Syndicate dog, attaches himself to a morally corrupt councilor and has countless deaths on his hands. Ten years have passed, if it weren't for me, would anyone have penalized him? Where is your justice then?
The weak detective remains silent for a moment, then looks back into Coquelic's eyes.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...Heh... You're not the first person to say that to me. "Because the world is so dark, justice doesn't exist, so it's okay for us to cross the line."

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: It's just an excuse to cover up your own misdeeds... I've read all the Garden's files...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: You keep talking about vengeance, but what you're really doing is spreading Mania with prohibited weapons. You contaminate a dozen civilians by killing one target. There are several cases of indiscriminate attacks on the FAC, all to undermine the anti-Mania efforts.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Because the world is a mess, your own evil deeds don't matter? Bullshit! Don't gloss over the bad things you've done, you're just as immoral! You're part of the evil!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: How many civilians in the city-state turn pale at the mention of the Garden? How many vile criminals imitate its actions to harm the innocent? Are you in total oblivion?
Coquelic looks at her with a smirk, suddenly sighs, and theatrically shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Sigh... hear that, Thistle? This is the "kindred spirit" you fought so hard to save.

The light comes on, revealing an injured assassin behind the screen. She's about the same age as Christina, covered in wounds, her face alternating between pale and bruised, the stains on her body eerily similar to Christina's.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: What...?
But Coquelic doesn't answer any more of Christina's questions. Instead, she turns to look at Thistle, her face full of mockery.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You went to great lengths to pull her out of the pile of Corruptors, thinking that shared experiences would breed empathy. But in her eyes, you're just a bastard. Your kindness is misplaced.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: If she knew how you're so infatuated, would a few shed tears and kind words from her make you hand over everything about the Garden in a crying mess?
Thistle doesn't dare look at Coquelic, she just glares at Christina, her eyes filled with anger, shame, and regret.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: I'm sorry... Mentor... forgive me...
But the apology only makes the Mentor even angrier.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Pathetic! I've told you before, stop caring about others so much. Now what are you crying and whining for? Do you want me to say "oh, it's okay, I forgive you" so you can feel better?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You act on your own, break my rules, bring the enemy into our base, and expect me to care about your feelings? Am I your mommy?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: What a pain! What little time I have for rest has been ruined by you and the dirty thing you brought back. Solitary confinement! You're not allowed out until I cool down.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Wait...
Christina struggles to yell, not at Coquelic, but at the Garden's assassin who's about to cry.
She stops in her tracks and turns around sharply. Christina suddenly doesn't know what to say.
Did you save me? Thank you? Is your family also with the FAC? I'm sorry, I didn't mean that? You shouldn't stay with this kind of woman? I'll take you away?
Before she can figure it out, the assassin speaks first.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: ...You should have died there, you domesticated scum!
Thistle leaves. Leaving Christina collapsed on the floor, with Coquelic standing by, taking pleasure in her misfortune.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: See, she's also a family member of the FAC, and also lost everything in N.F. 103. But she didn't have your connections. When she sought help from so-called justice, she only received resounding slaps in the face. So, she came to me.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: And then... you took advantage of her.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: It started with the Underground, and then you... you all deceive and exploit these wounded people under the guise of vengeance. You turn them into weapons that harm others when they have nothing left.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Even if her original life was destroyed, people are resilient. She could have slowly recovered, slowly returned to normal. But you lured her into darkness, and she can never go back!

As soon as she finishes speaking, Coquelic kicks Christina hard in the stomach. The injured detective crashes into a door pillar. Several sharp objects pierce Christina's body, and her consciousness immediately becomes chaotic.
She only feels something pressing against her head, squeezing hard.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Stop yapping. Is what the Hush gave you some kind of noble justice, and what I give is brainwashing with hatred? Who are you looking down on?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I know exactly what kind of person you are. You don't have the ability to take revenge on this world on your own, so you cling to the most hollow things as a lifeline.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: People like you are the easiest to deceive, the dumbest, and the weakest. If it weren't for the need to give that idiot Thistle a dose of reality, I wouldn't even bother to look at you.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The Garden won't believe your righteous talk, it won't believe any of you. Everything that demands submission in the name of love and nobility is a filthy lie. All sacrifices made for these extraneous things are proof of ignorance.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Those who dare to harm us must be punished by our own hands. This is the only way to personally take back what they took from me.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: So... what is this now? This series of cases, who are you taking revenge on?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...I've personally settled my deep hatred and grudge a long time ago. I'm free, and everything I do now is what I enjoy.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: As for what I'm going to do? Pass the message to your owner, let her play with me. That must be why she sent you here.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: After all... it's not like anyone really expects you to solve the case.
Several thin needles suddenly fly out, piercing Christina's body.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Mmph...!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Relax, this is just a little body recovery agent, with a little bit of a stimulant to help with your state of mind; to help you escape from here. As long as you don't remember the way back, I won't take your life.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Run, don't die on the way. The show's not over yet, I'm waiting for you to help raise the curtain.
